source_documents.role: autonomous architecture and four-candidate research queue

candidates.hypothesis: Pre-event relative spread, top-20 depth and top-20 imbalance define a frozen liquidity state; test post-event state transitions and incremental signed-flow information.
candidates.exact_measurable_definition: Use only pre-event features; construct frozen state bins before forward outcomes; compare L2-only, flow-only, L2-plus-flow and matched controls with event clustering.
candidates.why_different: Primary state-transition mechanism; not an SMC chart-label strategy.
candidates.next_research_stage: Acquire and validate timestamp-safe BTC/ETH historical L2, then run event study before directional modeling.

candidates.hypothesis: Causal liquidity depletion followed by replenishment may change subsequent displacement and execution cost.
candidates.exact_measurable_definition: Fixed-window normalized depth/spread deterioration, fixed-window recovery, then signed mid-price displacement, adverse/favorable excursion and execution-cost outcomes versus matched controls.
candidates.why_different: Sequence is depletion-to-recovery-to-outcome; no assumption of continuation or reversal and no SMC labels.
candidates.evidence_grade: C+ / plausible and testable, no independent validation
candidates.next_research_stage: Run after Priority 1 data audit using the same immutable L2 manifest.

candidates.hypothesis: Joint crowding, forced-flow and L2 deterioration may classify stressed or exhausted liquidity states.
candidates.exact_measurable_definition: Combine pre-registered crowding proxy, liquidation/forced-flow activity, low depth or high spread, and subsequent replenishment; evaluate event-level risk-state labels, not directional returns alone.
candidates.why_different: Initial target is capital-preservation regime state rather than entry direction.
candidates.next_research_stage: Build cascade event dataset; apply leave-one-event-out, placebo windows and news-shock stratification.

candidates.hypothesis: A synchronized liquidity or signed-flow change on one venue may precede a measurable response on another venue.
candidates.exact_measurable_definition: Estimate venue ordering only in development; measure lead-lag, response latency, basis, spread/depth response and transaction-cost-adjusted predictability under a fixed timestamp tolerance.
candidates.why_different: Cross-venue information migration, not a single-venue chart pattern or assumed leader.
candidates.next_research_stage: Complete forward OKX/Bybit collection and obtain a long synchronized venue archive before lead-lag estimation.

unsupported_claims_rejected: Any implied profitability or directional edge from the four candidates
Any assumption that order flow must add incremental information
Any automatic liquidation reversal or continuation signal
Any prop-firm readiness implication from risk-simulation thresholds
